$comment: Policy for learnings/ privacy. Enforced by scripts/validate-skill.mjs. See references/learning-sanitization.md for the agent-facing rule.
$sourceGameAllowlist_note: sourceGame: frontmatter MUST be one of these abstract codenames. A real studio/title name is itself a leak. The list is the union of the Unity and Unreal skills' allowlists, so lessons ported from them keep their codename. Add a new codename here at the START of each new client engagement (phase 1, before any learning is written). Use 'multiple' for a learning validated across several games. EXCEPTION: the engine vendor's own freely-published samples (Lyra, StackOBot) are listed under their real names — they belong to no client.
$apiMacroNote: Allowlisted macros are SDK exports and neutral placeholders. Any other *_API is flagged as a likely client module-export macro (e.g. STUDIONAME_API). Use GAME_API as the neutral placeholder in sanitized learnings.
$denylistNote: OPTIONAL belt-and-suspenders. The PRIMARY defense is the sanitization rule applied at write time (references/learning-sanitization.md) plus the hashed client-identifier guard in validate-skill.mjs (section 7) — this list is NOT a substitute. Leave empty unless an engagement wants a hard stop on a specific known token; client-specific denylists do not generalize and must never be the main control.
